name: updateSubcategoryAdvanced
description: Renames a subcategory or changes its icon, using the category's and the subcategory's ids.

categoryId.description: The category's id, as shown in search results.

subcategoryId.description: The subcategory's id, as shown in the category's search results.

newTitle.description: The subcategory's new name. Leave it out to keep the current one.

newIcon.description: A new picture for the subcategory, as a list holding one image; it replaces its font icon. Leave it out to keep the current icon.

newIconName.description: A new font icon for the subcategory, by its name; it replaces its picture. Leave it out to keep the current icon.

callback.description: Runs when the subcategory is changed.

error.description: Why it wasn't changed, such as no subcategory having that id.

result.description: The subcategory as it is now.

categoryId.description: The id of the category it belongs to.

iconUrl.description: The subcategory's picture, if it has one.

iconClassName.description: The subcategory's font icon, if it has one.
